wiki_acceptance: Drag-selecting rock cells -> a miner walks over and mines them, yielding stone.
summary: Added the missing player-facing DESIGNATION + miner-dispatch layer for mining, mirroring the just-shipped DeconstructDesignation.cs EXACTLY. The mining MECHANIC already existed end-to-end (PawnMiner.SetVeinTarget walks to a reserved adjacent stand cell via the existing TryReserveWorkStandPos + WorkGiveUp pathing and calls StoneVeinEntity.TakeMineDamage each tick; the vein drops stone chunks on depletion inside TakeMineDamage). Previously mining was auto-triggered by MineStoneAction picking the NEAREST vein with no designation gate; this wave adds the RimWorld-correct 'designate, then a miner mines it' flow. ZERO SceneSetup hot-file budget spent (toggle button self-attaches to the existing Canvas; the designation marker is a runtime code-built pick-glyph TextMesh). NO new pathfinding introduced. PawnMiner.cs needed NO edit (the mine action was already complete and reuses build/haul pathing wholesale). StoneVeinEntity.cs was NOT touched (no designation-aware accessor was needed — IsDestroyed already reports depletion).

design.manager_discipline: Mirrors DeconstructDesignation.cs / AlertStackUI.cs / RainSoundDriver.cs EXACTLY: [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(AfterSceneLoad)] spawns one hidden DontDestroyOnLoad GO; FindFirstObjectByType idempotency guard; READ-ONLY poll-find of BuildManager / DeconstructDesignation / Canvas / PawnMiners each frame (no OnEnable singleton capture - bug-pattern #7 firewall); timing via Time.unscaledTime deltas in Update, NOT a WaitForSeconds heartbeat (bug-pattern #9 firewall - no new always-on background timer).
design.mode: Mine mode toggled via self-built '채광 (M)' Canvas button + M hotkey. MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE with BOTH BuildManager build mode AND DeconstructDesignation deconstruct mode (entering mine cancels the other two; if either of the other two becomes active, mine leaves) so one left-click never fires two designation handlers. Right-click / ESC cancels.
design.designate: In mode, a left-press-then-drag sweeps a world-space rectangle of cells (MarkRect); a press-release-without-drag (< dragThreshold world units) is a single-cell click (MarkCell). Each covered cell is hit-tested at its CENTRE via Physics2D.OverlapBoxAll (matches ClickSelector/BuildManager.CellOccupied probing) — a StoneVeinEntity under it gets a MineTarget marker (pick '⛏' TextMesh, sortingOrder 30) + ClickEffect. Idempotent (re-mark returns existing marker). SimulateClick / SimulateDragRect expose pointer-free QA entry points.
design.dispatch: Throttled (0.5s) read-only poll: for each marked vein NOT already reserved (ReservationManager.IsReserved), find the nearest IDLE miner (HasTask==false, not drafted/sleeping/breaking/manual) and SetVeinTarget — exactly how MineStoneAction would, but gated on a player DESIGNATION and assigned by the manager to avoid editing the utility-AI files (out of lane). PawnMiner.SetVeinTarget reserves the vein itself, so the next tick sees it claimed and skips it (no double-assign).
design.action: REUSED WHOLESALE — PawnMiner.Update already walks to a reserved adjacent stand cell (TryReserveWorkStandPos), uses WorkGiveUp give-up, the same skill/trait/ability-scaled per-frame TakeMineDamage accumulation, and ClearTask on depletion. NO edit, NO new pathfinding.
design.yield_and_cleanup: Chunk-drop / stone yield is entirely the EXISTING StoneVeinEntity.TakeMineDamage path (drops 1-3 StoneChunkEntity, or AddStone fallback, then Destroy(gameObject)). The MineTarget marker lives only as long as the vein GameObject; on depletion the vein Destroys itself, the marker dies with it, and PruneMarked removes the null entry. StoneVeinEntity.cs untouched.

qa_flags: SCENE-WIRING (button): the '채광 (M)' mine-mode toggle button is created at RUNTIME on the first Canvas found (anchored bottom-center, x-offset +360 — opposite side from the Deconstruct button at -360 — y inset 104 above the bar). NOT wired in any SceneSetup file. QA: confirm the button appears, click toggles mine mode (active highlight), the M hotkey toggles it, and it is mutually exclusive with the build ghost and the deconstruct '해체' mode (entering one cancels the others; one left-click fires one handler).

SCENE-WIRING (marker): the designation marker is a code-generated pick '⛏' TextMesh (Arial OS font, sortingOrder 30) parented to the marked vein — no imported PNG / no prefab / no SceneSetup ref. QA: confirm a pick glyph appears on a designated vein and disappears when the vein is mined out.

VERIFY #16 end-to-end: enter mine mode, drag a rectangle (or click) over rock/ore cells -> a '⛏' marker appears on each StoneVeinEntity inside; an idle colonist (PawnMiner) walks to an adjacent reserved stand cell and mines it until depleted; the vein drops stone chunks (or stone count rises) on depletion. Wiki #16 acceptance: 'Drag-selecting rock cells -> a miner walks over and mines them, yielding stone.'

BEHAVIOR NOTE (not a bug): the EXISTING MineStoneAction (PawnActions.cs) still auto-targets the nearest vein with no designation — left intact and untouched to stay in lane. So a free miner may still auto-mine an undesignated vein via the utility AI; the NEW designation layer adds player-directed priority dispatch on TOP of that. If the operator wants mining to become DESIGNATION-ONLY (RimWorld-strict: pawns mine ONLY designated veins), that is a tiny follow-up edit to MineStoneAction.FindNearestVein to require a MineTarget — FLAGGED here, NOT done this lane (PawnActions.cs is out of lane A).
NO HOT-FILE EDIT this wave: the lane's single SceneSetup hot-file budget was NOT spent (Deconstruct's self-attach pattern reused).
